welcome: Coffee Advisor. Free crop advice by SMS. Describe your coffee plants, or send PRICE for market rates, HELP for options, STOP to opt out.
help: Send PRICE for coffee prices, or describe what you see on your plants (leaves, berries). STOP to opt out. We alert an agent when unsure.
prices: UCDA farm-gate prices {date}: {body} UGX per kg.
prices_unavailable: Prices are not available right now. Please try again later.
stop_ack: You will get no more messages. Send START to resume.
start_ack: Welcome back. Describe your coffee plants, or send PRICE.
clarify: To be sure: are the marks on the leaves or on the berries, and what colour are they?
unsure: I am not sure what this is. A field agent has been alerted and will contact you.
followup_q: How are your coffee plants 3 days on? Reply 1 better, 2 same, 3 worse.
followup_ok: Good. Keep following the advice. Send a new message any time.
followup_worse: Sorry to hear that. A field agent has been alerted and will contact you.
